messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick check — finalizing run-of-show for the May 12 webinar. Need speaker confirmations, short 2-line abstracts, and rehearsal availability. TL;DR: 40m session, 3 demos, 10m Q&A.
AJ Patel: Confirmed. I can do rehearsals next Tue/Wed afternoons.
Maria Gomez: I'm in — abstract below in thread. Prefer a morning rehearsal if possible.
Kevin Li: I can present demo 2. Can someone confirm demo env SLA and fallback plan?
Jenna Park: Draft abstract: "How to cut token costs without sacrificing latency: practical batching, prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs." Two lines — keep punchy?
Olivia Chen: Love it, Jenna. Shorten to: "Reduce inference cost while keeping low-latency UX using batching, caching, and model variants."
Bryan Scott: For demo fallback: plan is recorded demo + prerecorded clip stored in S3. If live GPUs spike >85% we flip to video.
Kevin Li: That works. Can we also add simple simulated traffic script to the runbook?
Olivia Chen: Yes — Bryan, can you attach the runbook snippet here later? Also we need a 1-slide speaker bio and headshot by EOD Friday.
Maria Gomez: Quick note: I have a conflict 5/10-5/11 AM PT. Available 5/9 or 5/12 morning.
AJ Patel: Shared my 2-line abstract: "Designing robust routing policies across hosted, dedicated, and private inference for predictable latency and cost."
Olivia Chen: Perfect. Now the proposed run-of-show (approx):
```
00:00-02:00 Intro + exec summary (Olivia)
02:00-12:00 Talk 1: Cost controls (Jenna) + slides
12:00-22:00 Live demo 1 (model quantization) + Q/A
22:00-25:00 Break + transition
25:00-32:00 Live demo 2 (routing + fallback) Kevin + Bryan
32:00-36:00 Rapid customer use-cases (AJ)
36:00-40:00 Closing + next steps + CTA + 10m extended Q/A if needed
```
Olivia Chen: Comments? Keep timings tight — demos must be <10m each.
Jenna Park: Can we reorder so Kevin goes first? His demo has more setup.
Olivia Chen: Good call — swap demos 1/2.
Bryan Scott: Runbook snippet (short): `if live_demo_failure then switch_to_recorded(video_s3_path) and post notice in chat + alert ops`.
Kevin Li: I'll add a 1-paragraph troubleshooting checklist to the runbook.
AJ Patel: Rehearsal slots: Tue 3-4pm PT, Wed 10-11am PT, Thu 9-10am PT. Preferred: Tue 3pm.
Olivia Chen: Marking Tue 3pm as primary rehearsal. event-bot: Calendar invites sent to confirmed participants for 1714202022 Tue 15:00 PT rehearsal.
event-bot: Recording enabled for rehearsal.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: got the invite.
Jenna Park: I'll shorten my slides to 6 max and rehearse transitions.
Olivia Chen: Thanks — last logistics: who will handle audience poll at 15:30? We want a quick 1-question poll after demo 1.
AJ Patel: I can run the poll. Simple multiple choice: "Which tradeoff matters most for you?
A) Cost B) Latency C) Ease of deployment D) Data control"
Olivia Chen: Nice. Also need a short tweet + LinkedIn copy for launch. I'll draft and post for review before EOD.
Bryan Scott: I'll upload the fallback video and paste the S3 link in the runbook channel once done.
Olivia Chen: Awesome team — please drop final 2-line abstracts and headshots by EOD Fri. We'll do a 20m dry run at Tue rehearsal and a full run Wed if needed.
AJ Patel: Got it.
Maria Gomez: Will upload headshot Friday morning.
Jenna Park: Uploading slides now.
Kevin Li: Troubleshooting checklist added to the runbook.
Olivia Chen: Closing thread — if anything critical pops up ping me directly. Thanks all! :rocket:
